svg.title: Isoline map
svg.desc: Lines of equal travel time to the nearest clinic at 30, 60 and 90 minutes, in darkening teal, with clinics as small black diamonds. The lines bunch around the clinics and open out in the more remote areas.
svg.text: Travel time by road to the nearest clinic, 2026
